headline: 英塗鴉藝術家Helch逝世
context: 英國知名塗鴉藝術家 Helch 過世。他自 2018 年起以自己的化名在英格蘭南部各地繪製招牌塗鴉而聲名大噪，作品也曾讓已故英國女王伊莉莎白二世不滿，並多次與開發商為了塗鴉空間角力。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Artist rose to prominence in 2018 by painting his eponymous tag in public spots across southern England The graffiti artist who left an indelible mark on high-rise Britain The street artist Helch, known for murals and tags across England, has died, his gallery has said. He rose to prominence in 2018 by painting his eponymous tag in capital letters across a string of public spots in London as well as bridges on the M4, M1 and M25. Continue reading...
sources.title: Prolific UK graffiti artist Helch dies

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: He upset Queen Elizabeth II, defied the developers and had to scrap for every inch of graffiti space in a gentrified, urban landscape • Prolific UK graffiti artist Helch dies You know you’ve made an impact when the headlines upon your death are filled with words like “iconic”, “infamous”, “world class” and “upset Queen Elizabeth II”. By that measure, graffiti supremo Helch made a pretty serious mark on the world. He died this week , leaving behind a country pockmarked by his tag, a giant towering HELCH, though sometimes reduced to just a simple upper-case H. It was on railway bridges and motorway overpasses, on derelict buildings and decrepit high rises. From Bristol to London, Helch was everywhere. He was even on a railway viaduct on the way to Windsor Castle, in 60ft high white letters, “ruining” the view of poor old Elizabeth’s home and apparently leaving our late monarch in an absolute rage. Continue reading...
sources.title: HRH Helch: the graffiti artist who left an indelible mark on high-rise Britain

thread_text: 英國知名塗鴉藝術家 Helch 過世。他從 2018 年起以自己的化名在英格蘭南部各地繪製招牌塗鴉，因此聲名大噪，作品也曾讓已故英國女王伊莉莎白二世不滿，長年為了在都市開發區塊爭取每一寸塗鴉空間，跟開發商角力。本則整理自衛報報導。
threads_text: 英國知名塗鴉藝術家 Helch 過世的消息，這幾天登上不少英國媒體版面。他從 2018 年起，以自己的化名在英格蘭南部各地繪製招牌塗鴉而聲名大噪，作品風格強烈，甚至一度讓已故英國女王伊莉莎白二世感到不滿。在都市快速仕紳化的年代，他也長年跟開發商角力，為了每一寸能塗鴉的牆面空間據理力爭。本則整理自衛報報導。
